test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’.**

Ram ran back to the / window to see the bars dangling / a few feet before the ground.

options.text: window to see the bars dangling
a few feet before the ground.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"a few feet before the ground."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use **"above"** in the blank is to convey the spatial relationship between the dangling bars and the ground.
 
• Using **"above"** clarifies that the bars are suspended at a certain height relative to the ground, emphasizing the distance between them.
 
• This choice of preposition helps provide a clearer picture of the scene and the positioning of the bars in relation to the ground.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

**Correct sentence**: *Ram ran back to the window to see the bars dangling a few feet **above**__ the ground. *
